## Problem

A rendered view is a static file. It goes stale while execute-phase changes records.

## Approach

Not yet scoped. Direction: an adaptive-artifacts `watch --id <view>` command that polls the view's store-state digest and redraws in place. Decide at plan-phase.

## Exit criteria

Not yet scoped. Decide at plan-phase.
